name: Hakkim Shajahan
bio: Hakkim Shjahan is an Indian actor from Kerala, works in Malayalam and Tamil films

credits.title: Jailer 2
credits.overview: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

credits.title: I, Nobody
credits.overview: Rajeevan, an ordinary government employee, witnesses something he was never meant to see and is thrust into the centre of a serious crime. Branded a troublemaker and hunted by the system, he must protect his family while fighting to survive against forces far beyond his control.

credits.title: Pennu Case
credits.overview: A group of men realize that they are all the victim of the same serial wedding scammer.

credits.title: Mirage
credits.overview: A woman joins forces with a journalist to investigate secrets her fiancé was keeping from her after she is informed he has died in a tragic train accident.

credits.title: Meesha
credits.overview: A forest guard, Midhun, invites his old friends to a reunion in the woods. What starts as a warm get-together slowly turns into a night of tension, betrayal, and survival, as secrets unravel and friendships crack under pressure.

credits.title: Bazooka
credits.overview: A cop and a businessman team up on a mission to capture a serial killer, using a series of elaborate games to track him down.

credits.title: Theatre
credits.overview: A cattle farmer who aspires to be a stage actor, Das works with a cosmopolitan theatre troupe headed by an ill-tempered, foul-mouthed director. When the director’s tantrums unearth buried resentments among the group’s members, the play they are rehearsing threatens to come apart.

credits.title: Sorgavaasal
credits.overview: A common man imprisoned in a corrupt system questions whether jails truly rehabilitate or push individuals deeper into crime's abyss.

credits.title: Oru Kattil Oru Muri
credits.overview: The film's narrative revolves around a bed and its three occupants. It follows Rugmangadan, who wakes up in his car and is pursued by goons.

credits.title: Kadha Innuvare
credits.overview: An anthology of four unusual stories where each couple fights to be with the ones they love against all odds.

credits.title: Kadakan
credits.overview: Reckless youth Sulfi and rebel father Hyder Ali live in Nilambur when incidents endanger their lives.

credits.title: Pranaya Vilasam
credits.overview: A revelation about a woman's old flame sends shockwaves through her family. Portrays love stories of different characters who are at different stages of their lives.

credits.title: The Teacher
credits.overview: PE teacher Devika and her husband have been trying to be pregnant for four years. Their equation changes after she becomes pregnant and when she reveals that she has been abused by four students during a sports meet.

credits.title: Vishudha Mejo
credits.overview: Mejo`s childhood friend Jeena returns to his coastal village after completing her higher-education in Chennai. As she spends time with Mejo, he slowly starts developing feelings for her. Being an introvert, will Mejo ever get the confidence to propose?

credits.title: Priyan Ottathilaanu
credits.overview: Dr. Priyadarshan, a middle class man, silently goes through the pangs of hyperactivity and ADHD that entangles him into a series of coincidental events. He then meets Priscilla, a feisty, constantly doubtful and depressed girl.

credits.title: Dear Friend
credits.overview: Vinod, Shyam, Arjun, Sajith and Jannath are friends residing in Bengaluru. They live, eat and party together and share a beautiful bond. credits.title: Archana 31 Not Out
credits.overview: After multiple marriage proposals flop due to a variety of reasons, Archana is happy that Middle-East-based Prasad is, finally, interested in marrying her. While the household celebrates the pre-wedding night, Archana grapples with an information that comes her way, out of the blue.

credits.title: Kadaseela Biriyani
credits.overview: A studious teen who wants a simple life is conned by his violent older brothers into joining their grandiose plan to avenge their murdered father.

credits.title: Nayattu
credits.overview: Three police officers are forced to go on the run when they get tangled in the death of a youth, a few days before the election.

credits.overview: On a rainy evening, Chandra decides to reveal an intimate matter to her husband, Das. It would change their worlds forever shattering whatever they had known about each other. Would they be having the strength to continue their lives as usual after realizing that truth?

credits.title: Nonsense
credits.overview: A bright but misunderstood student, who has a passion for BMX and a love for science, in his search for humanity. His faith in humanity is tested when something unexpected happens.

credits.title: Koode
credits.overview: Following the loss of his sister, a young man is forced to reflect on his childhood and reassess his future. However, he finds support and courage from unexpected quarters.

credits.title: Naam
credits.overview: A group of six guys and three girls who meet in college become thick friends and eventually take their friendship beyond the classroom and the campus. All goes well for the group until they are faced with sudden crisis. The event strengthens the group's bond as they struggle hard to overcome the situation.

credits.title: Rakshadhikari Baiju (Oppu)
credits.overview: A kind-hearted government employee in his forties, who spends most of his time with youngsters, selflessly intervenes in the problems of his near and dear ones.

credits.title: ABCD: American-Born Confused Desi
credits.overview: The story revolves around two spoiled youngsters, Jones and his cousin Korah and the turn of events during their vacation.
